config.//1a: pgoutput ships with Postgres 10+, so there is no extension to install and no version skew with wal2json/decoderbufs.
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.slot.name: fineract_cdc_slot
config.publication.name: fineract_cdc_pub
config.//1b: The publication is declared in SQL (04_cdc_publication.sql) and owned by git. 'disabled' tells Debezium to use it as-is instead of attempting an ALTER that requires publication ownership.
config.//2a: Topics become fineract.oltp.<table>, matching the ClickHouse Kafka engine tables one-for-one.
config.//3a: 'initial' takes a consistent snapshot of the capture set, then streams. Recovery from an expired slot is therefore automatic rather than a manual backfill.
config.//3b: Signalling table enables ad-hoc incremental re-snapshots of a single table without stopping the connector or replaying the whole publication.
config.//4: ---------- type handling (the part that silently corrupts data if you get it wrong) ----------
config.//4a: Default is 'precise', which encodes NUMERIC as base64 bytes + scale. Correct, but every downstream consumer then has to decode it. 'string' keeps full precision in a form ClickHouse can cast with toDecimal64OrNull - no float rounding on money.
config.//4b: DATE columns arrive as int32 days-since-epoch, which is exactly ClickHouse's internal Date representation - toDate(<int>) is a no-op cast.
config.//4c: hstore/interval are not used by this schema but pinning the mode avoids surprises if they are added later.
config.//5a: Schemas are disabled: ClickHouse parses JSON values, not Kafka Connect envelopes. Halves message size and removes the schema registry from the critical path.
config.//6a: unwrap flattens Debezium's before/after envelope to a plain row. delete.handling.mode=rewrite keeps deletes as tombstone-flagged rows (__deleted=true) instead of dropping them, which is what lets ReplacingMergeTree(is_deleted) reconcile a delete rather than leave a ghost row.
config.//6b: source.ts_ms is the commit time in the SOURCE database. It - not ts_ms, which is when Debezium read the record - is the correct version column for ReplacingMergeTree and the correct basis for end-to-end lag.
config.//7a: Without a heartbeat, an idle capture set means the slot's confirmed LSN never advances and Postgres retains WAL until the disk fills. This is the single most common way a working CDC pipeline takes down its source database at 3am.
config.heartbeat.action.query: UPDATE cdc.debezium_heartbeat SET beat_at = now() WHERE id = 1
config.//8a: errors.tolerance=none: a message we cannot serialise is a bug, not noise. Failing loudly beats silently dropping a financial event.
config.//9a: acks=all + idempotence: no silently lost change events on a broker failover. lz4 + linger trades 50ms of latency for a large drop in broker I/O.
